posts.markdown:

posts.title: A technical deep dive into the new release
posts.markdown:
We rewrote the launcher's search from scratch. Here is why, and what it cost.

## The index

Results are ranked by what you used recently and where you used it, computed on device. Nothing leaves your machine.

```text
score = frecency * context_match
```
